source.title: 122. Milosrđe Božje - Što je značenje sve opreme Božje?

summary.title_hr: 122. Milosrđe Božje - Što je značenje sve opreme Božje?
summary.abstract_hr: Epizoda medija Ora et Labora ima molitveno-katehetski karakter. Počinje molitvom oslobođenja, posvetnim molitvama, Krunicom Božjega milosrđa s litanijama te Gospinom krunicom s otajstvima svjetla. U središnjem dijelu govornik tumači odlomak iz Poslanice Efežanima o 'svoj opremi Božjoj' (istina, oklop pravednosti, spremnost za evanđelje mira, štit vjere, kaciga spasenja i mač duha). Pritom posebno naglašava povjerenje u Boga i u bližnje te sumnju kao glavno đavlovo oružje. Zatim tumači evanđelje dana (Lk 13,31-35) o Isusovoj neustrašivosti pred Herodom i ustrajnosti u vršenju volje Božje te ga primjenjuje na današnje stanje u Hrvatskoj. Epizoda završava najavama promocija knjige i domoljubne inicijative Ora et Labora po gradovima, svjedočanstvom o ozdravljenju i pozivom na javnu molitvu krunice na trgovima.
key_topics: molitva oslobođenja i krunica božjeg milosrđa
sva oprema božja prema poslanici efežanima
povjerenje i sumnja u vjeri i zajednici
istina naspram onoga što je istinito

speakers.suggested_name: Voditelj (prema metapodacima epizodu je pripremio dr. sc. Vladimir Grebenar, bacc. theol.)

key_points: Govornik prema svetom Pavlu ističe da se vjernici ne bore protiv ljudi, nego protiv zlih duhova. Prema njegovim riječima, onoga tko je pod vlašću zloga može se prepoznati po tome što progoni ljude koji donose plodove za kraljevstvo Božje.
Govornik razlikuje 'istinito' od 'istine': ljudi iznose istinite argumente koji im odgovaraju, a istina je samo jedna. 'Opasati bedra istinom' znači tumačiti događaje kroz riječ Božju.
Oklop pravednosti tumači kao vršenje volje Božje, koje je teško, ali donosi Božju zaštitu. Taj oklop čovjek ne može sam obući, nego mu ga Bog mora dati.
Štit vjere opisuje kao povjerenje u Boga i u ljude s kojima se nešto gradi. Sumnju naziva najjačim đavlovim oružjem koje vodi do izdaje, a izdaju naziva najtežim grijehom.

Kacigu spasenja tumači kao podređivanje razuma srcu i svijest o smrti i posljednjem sudu. Mač duha tumači kao riječ Božju i proroštvo te naglašava da onaj tko tvrdi da je sigurno nešto primio od Boga time pokazuje da nije od Boga.

U tumačenju evanđelja govornik ističe da se Isus nije bojao Heroda, nazvao ga je lisicom i nastavio vršiti volju Očevu. Isusov plač nad Jeruzalemom primjenjuje na Hrvatsku, gdje se, kako kaže, Gospa ukazuje 45 godina, a umjesto jedinstva vladaju podjele i zavist.

Svjedočanstvo slušateljice Branke govori o zacjeljenju rane na suprugovu ramenu nakon molitve i polaganja ruke. Govornik to povezuje s porukom koju je, kako kaže, primio u molitvi da supruga treba polagati ruke na muža.

key_topics_en: prayer of deliverance and chaplet of divine mercy
whole armor of god according to the epistle to the ephesians
trust and doubt in faith and community
doing the will of god and readiness
key_points_en: According to Saint Paul, the speaker emphasizes that believers do not fight against people, but against evil spirits. According to his words, one who is under the dominion of the evil one can be recognized by the fact that he persecutes people who bear fruit for the kingdom of God.

The speaker distinguishes 'what is true' from 'truth': people present true arguments that suit them, but the truth is only one. 'Girding the loins with truth' means interpreting events through the word of God.
He interprets the breastplate of righteousness as doing the will of God, which is difficult, but brings God's protection. Man cannot put on this armor by himself; God must give it to him.

He describes the shield of faith as trust in God and in the people with whom something is being built. He calls doubt the devil's strongest weapon leading to betrayal, and he calls betrayal the gravest sin.

He interprets the helmet of salvation as subordinating reason to the heart and the awareness of death and final judgment. He interprets the sword of the Spirit as the word of God and prophecy, emphasizing that whoever claims to have definitely received something from God thereby shows that he is not from God.

In interpreting the gospel, the speaker emphasizes that Jesus was not afraid of Herod, called him a fox, and continued to do the will of the Father. He applies Jesus' weeping over Jerusalem to Croatia, where, as he says, Our Lady has been appearing for 45 years, yet instead of unity, divisions and envy prevail.

The testimony of listener Branka speaks of the healing of a wound on her husband's shoulder after prayer and the laying on of hands. The speaker connects this with a message that he says he received in prayer that a wife should lay hands on her husband.

summary.title_en: 122. Divine Mercy - What is the meaning of all the armor of God?
summary.abstract_en: The episode of the media Ora et Labora has a prayer-catechetical character. It begins with a prayer of deliverance, prayers of consecration, the Chaplet of Divine Mercy with litanies, and Our Lady's Rosary with the luminous mysteries. In the central part, the speaker interprets a passage from the Epistle to the Ephesians on the 'whole armor of God' (truth, breastplate of righteousness, readiness for the gospel of peace, shield of faith, helmet of salvation, and sword of the Spirit). In doing so, he particularly emphasizes trust in God and in one's neighbors, and doubt as the devil's main weapon. He then interprets the gospel of the day (Lk 13:31-35) about Jesus' fearlessness before Herod and perseverance in doing the will of God, applying it to today's situation in Croatia. The episode concludes with announcements of book promotions and the patriotic initiative Ora et Labora across cities, a testimony of healing, and a call to public prayer of the Rosary in town squares.
